parsed.explanation: The dossier documents active, escalating state enforcement plus severe societal violence with essentially no recourse. The 2026 amendment explicitly names transsexuality in its promotion/financing/support ban, so the regime reaches trans identity, not only same-sex conduct; penalties rose to 5–10 years (some defendants facing 20 years), arrests cluster around political moments, include border-post detention and second-hand reports, and police torture in custody is documented. Mob violence reaches extreme severity (a body exhumed and burned before a crowd of hundreds). No legal gender recognition, no anti-discrimination law, UPR recommendations for decriminalisation and orientation-based violence protections refused, LGBT groups driven underground, media silence making the incident list a floor. Societal hostility is threat-framed, not mere friction, and recourse is thin or absent. No documented universal facility/custody rule or execution campaign, so not the extreme band.
